fullDescription: A warm catalogue deck whose signature is a script line crossing straight THROUGH the giant rounded headline as a layer, not sitting under it as a caption. A full-height flat panel holds the deck's furniture down one side while the type field rags left, so the split is asymmetric rather than centred. Butter, deep teal and one tomato accent. Good for product catalogues, stationery and craft studios, menus, small-brand lookbooks and any deck that should feel made by hand rather than shipped by a template.
prompt:
## Resumo
A warm catalogue deck whose signature is a script tagline crossing THROUGH a giant rounded headline as a layer, against an asymmetric split with a full-height colour panel.

## Estilo Visual
Apply a warm craft-catalogue style. Palette: ground #F7E6A9, display and body ink #0E5A55 (plus 60/25% for secondary), accent #D9542F used ONLY for the script line and spec labels. Typography: 'Baloo 2' 800 for display at line-height 0.9; 'Petit Formal Script' for the crossing tagline; 'Karla' 400-700 for body and for corner tags, uppercase at letter-spacing 0.24em. Colour fields are FLAT. DO NOT put the script across the junction between two display lines — it disappears into the solid strokes; it must cross ONE line through its lower third.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Cover
Left field: a tracked-caps kicker, then the brand name as two stacked display lines at about 232px, with the script tagline at 126px rotated -7 degrees crossing through the LOWER THIRD of the first line only. A short paragraph of two lines sits well below. Right panel: a year in the display face at 94px, an inline-SVG envelope with a solid wax seal in the accent colour, and a two-line uppercase caption, all centred in the panel. Corner tags top-left and bottom-left.

### Specimen grid
A display heading at 126px with the script crossing it, an intro of three lines, then a two-by-two grid of specimens. Each cell is a 96px flat colour swatch with a 2px border beside a bold 36px name, a two-line description in the 60% ink, and a spec line in the accent colour, uppercase at 17px — each cell separated by a 2px rule above it. Right panel: one large figure at 180px, a two-line uppercase label, and a short note lower down.

### Closer
Invert to a teal ground with butter type, keeping the same left-stacked composition rather than centring it. Two display lines at about 206px with the script crossing the first, a two-line address block below, and the envelope SVG restated larger on the right — one envelope, not a mirrored pair. A symmetric pair of the same ornament is filler and reads as generated.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### The crossing script — A script line layered THROUGH the display type, not captioned beneath it.
Set the script in the accent colour at roughly half the display size, rotate it about -5 to -7 degrees, give it a higher z-index, and position it so it crosses the LOWER THIRD of a single display line — enough overlap that it is unmistakably a layer, little enough that both stay readable. Open space below the crossed line so the descenders have air. Crossing the gap between two stacked display lines buries it in solid strokes and kills both; cross one line only.

### The furniture panel — A full-height flat panel that carries what changes.
A flat rectangle in the display colour, full height, occupying roughly the right 29% of the stage. Its CONTENTS change on every slide — a year, a count, a mark — while its position and colour never do. Everything inside is centred and set in the ground colour. Give it no border, no shadow and no rounding: it is a field, not a card.
